arabic_text: يامَنْ لاتَنْقَضِي عَجَائِبُ عَظَمَتِهِ،
transliteration: yamann la tanqadi ʿaja'ibu ʿazhamatih
english_text: O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاحْجُبْنَا عَنِ الالْحَادِ فِي عَظَمَتِكَ.
transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-aḥjubnā ʿani al-ilhādī fī ʿaẓamatika
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and prevent us from deviation concerning Thy mightiness!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
transliteration: wa yā man lā tantahī muddatu mulkih
english_text: O He the term of whose kingdom will never cease!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَعْتِقْ رِقَابَنَا مِنْ نَقِمَتِك.
transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa'a'tiq riqa'bana min naqimati-ka
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and release our necks from Thy vengeance!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
transliteration: wa yā man lā tafnā khazā'inu raḥmatihi
english_text: O He the treasuries of whose mercy will never be exhausted!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْ لَنا نَصِيباً فِي رَحْمَتِكَ.
transliteration: ṣallī ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-jʿal lana naṣīban fī raḥmatik
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and appoint for us a portion of Thy mercy!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الابْصَارُ،
transliteration: wa yā man tanqaṭiʿu dūna rūyatihi al-abṣārُ،
english_text: O He whom eyes fall short of seeing!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَدْنِنَا إلَى قُرْبِكَ.
transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ʾālih wa ʾadnina ila qurbika
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and bring us close to Thy nearness!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الاخْطَارُ،
transliteration: wa yā man taṣghuru ʿinda khaṭarihi al-aḫṭār
english_text: O He before whose greatness all great things are small!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَكَرِّمْنَا عَلَيْكَ.
transliteration: ṣallī ʿalā muḥammad wa-ālih wa karrimnā ʿalayk
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and give us honour with Thee!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الاخْبَارِ،
transliteration: wayā man taẓharu ʿindahu bawāṭin al-akhbār
english_text: O He to whom all hidden tidings are manifest!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَلاَ تَفْضَحْنَا لَدَيْكَ.
transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih walā tafḍaḥnā ladayka
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household and expose us not before Thee!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهّابِيْنَ بِهِبَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا وَحْشَةَ الْقَاطِعِين بِصِلَتِكَ ، حَتّى لا نَرْغَبَ إلَى أحَد مَعَ بَذْلِكَ، وَلاَ نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أحَد مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma aghnina ʿan hibati al-wahhābīna bihibatika wākfinā waḥshata al-qāṭiʿīn bi ṣilatika ḥattá lā narghaba ʾilá ʾaḥad maʿa bazlik walā nastawḥiša min ʾaḥad maʿa faḍlika
english_text: O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Thy gift, spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Thy joining, that we may beseech no one along with Thy free giving, that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Thy bounty!

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَكِدْ لَنَا وَلا تَكِدْ عَلَيْنَا، وَامْكُرْ لَنَا وَلاَ تَمْكُرْ بنَا، وَأدِلْ لَنَا وَلاَ تُدِلْ مِنّا.
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih wa kid lana wa la takid ʿalayna wamkur lanā walā tamkur banā wa adil lana wa la tudil minna
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, scheme for us, not against us, devise to our benefit, not to our loss, give the turn to prevail to us, not to others!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إلَيْكَ، وَلاَ تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إنّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waqinā minka, waḥfiẓnā bika, wahdīnā ilayk walā tubāʿidnā ʿanka inna man taqihī yaslam wa man tahdihī yaʿlam, wa man tuqarribuhu ilayka yaghnam
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, protect us from Thyself, safeguard us through Thyself, guide us to Thyself, and take us not far from Thyself! he whom Thou protectest stays safe, he whom Thou guidest knows, and he whom Thou bringest near Thyself takes the spoils.

arabic_text: الّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْفِنَا حَدَّ نَوائِبِ الزَّمَانِ، وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشّيطانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wakfinā ḥadda nawāʾibi al-zamān wa sharra maṣāʾid al-shayṭān wa marārata ṣawlati al-sulṭān
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes, the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's aggression!

arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ إنَّما يَكْتَفِي الْمُكْتَفُونَ بِفَضْـل قُوَّتِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى محَمَّد وَآلِهِ ،وَاكْفِنَا
transliteration: allāhumma innamā yaktafī al-muktafūna bifaḍl quwwatika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih, wakfinā
english_text: O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty of Thy strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

arabic_text: وَإنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ و اعطنا
transliteration: wa innamā yuʿti al-muʿtuun min faḍli jidatika fa salli `ala muhammad wa alihi wa 'atina
english_text: The givers give only through the bounty of Thy wealth, so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!

arabic_text: وَإنمَا يَهْتَدِي الْمُهْتَدُونَ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى محمّد وَآلِهِ وَاهْدِنَا .
transliteration: wa innamā yahdī al-muhtadūna binūri wajhika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ahdi-nā
english_text: The guided are guided only by the light of Thy face, so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

arabic_text: اللّهُمَّ إنّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ، وَمَنْ أعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْـعُ الْمَانِعِينَ، وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إضْلاَلُ المُضِلِّيْنَ.
transliteration: allahumma innaka man waliyta lam yadurruhu khidhlanu al-khazileen wa man aʿtayta lam yanqus-hu manʿu al-maniʿīn wa-man hadayta lam yughwih iḍlalu al-muḍillīn
english_text: O God, he whom Thou befriendest will not be injured by the abandonment of the abandoners, he to whom Thou givest will not be diminished by the withholding of the withholders, he whom Thou guidest will not be misled by the misguidance of the misguiders.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَأغْنِنَا عَنْ غَيْرِكَ بِإرْفَادِكَ وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَ الْحَقِّ بِـإرْشَادِكَ.
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih, wa amnaʿnā biʿizzika, min ʿibādik waʾaghninā ʿan ghayrika biʾirfādika wasluk bina sabil alhaqq bi irshadik
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Thy servants through Thy might, free us from need for other than Thee through Thy support, and make us travel the path of the Truth through Thy right guidance!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَانْطِلاَقَ أَلْسِنَتِنَا فِي وَصْفِ مِنَّتِكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wajʿal salāmata qulūbinā fī dhikri ʿaẓamatika wa farāgha abdāninā fī shukri niʿmatika wa-inṭilāqa ʾalsinatina fī waṣfi minnatika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and put the soundness of our hearts into the remembrance of Thy mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Thy favour, and the flow of our tongues into the description of Thy kindness!

arabic_text: أللَهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ دُعَاتِكَ الدّاعِينَ إلَيْكَ وَهُدَاتِكَ الدَّالّينَ عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْ خَاصَّتِكَ الْخَاصِّينَ لَدَيْكَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wajʿalna min duʿaatika addāʿīna ilayk wa hudatika al-dālīn ʿalayka wa min khaṣṣatika al-khāṣṣīna ladayka
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and make us one of Thy summoners who summon to Thee, Thy guiders who direct to Thee, and Thy special friends whom Thou hast singled out!

arabic_text: يَا أرْحَمَ ألرَّاحِمِينَ .
transliteration: yā ar-raḥmaan
english_text: O Most Merciful of the merciful!
